memory_lessons.applicability: A reciprocal-distance variant should be tested separately from target-mass cancellation when diagnosing numerical differences.
memory_lessons.claim: The prior candidate combining rsqrt-based inverse-distance cubing with target-mass cancellation failed one protected case at n=16384 (maximum absolute error 0.0003108978271484375). The combined change does not identify which transformation caused the failure.
memory_lessons.next_experiment: Measure this isolated, Newton-refined reciprocal formulation; only pursue target-mass factoring separately if it passes correctness.

proposal.hypothesis: Using a Newton-refined rsqrt reciprocal cube may replace the per-pair square root, denominator multiplication, and division with reciprocal-square-root and multiply operations. This candidate preserves the original force numerator, accumulation, and target-mass division to isolate the reciprocal formulation after the prior combined variant failed correctness; the controller must validate tolerance and the geometric-mean objective.

retained: Replace sqrtf plus the distance denominator multiplication and division with rsqrtf, one Newton refinement, and an inverse-distance cube.
Preserve the original force numerator, accumulation order, and target-mass division to isolate the reciprocal-distance change.
Skip Newton refinement when the reciprocal is zero, avoiding an infinity-times-zero intermediate for infinite squared distance.
